infectious.position: Don't build your infectious-disease line SKU-by-SKU — lead with the combos (dengue NS1+IgM/IgG, malaria Pf/Pan) that widen the diagnostic window and cut your inventory and registration burden.
reasoning: Combined devices cover early and late phases in one SKU, reducing the number of products to stock and document.
Tropical and field buyers prioritize room-temperature stability and instrument-free formats.
Confirm CE scope per product line before committing to a regulated market.

doa.position: Lead with the multi-panel cup with adulteration checks — it is the highest-value DOA SKU for workplace programs, not the single-analyte strip.
reasoning: Panel cups with pH/specific-gravity/oxidant strips detect tampering at the point of collection.
SAMHSA-style cut-offs make the product defensible in regulated workplace testing.
Every positive is presumptive — sell the confirmatory workflow, not just the strip.

cardiac-tumor.position: Position cardiac rapid tests as triage tools and tumor markers as monitoring aids — overselling either one will backfire on you and your buyers.
reasoning: POC cardiac markers are triage-grade; high-sensitivity lab assays remain the clinical standard.
Tumor markers rise in benign conditions too — they support monitoring, not standalone diagnosis.
Hospitals buy panels (troponin + CK-MB + myoglobin + D-dimer), so bundle rather than sell single markers.

womens-health.position: For pregnancy and fertility tests, compete on packaging and private label, not on the chemistry — hCG and LH are commodity tests, so retail differentiation is the real moat.
reasoning: hCG/LH/FSH are high-volume, low-complexity — buyers choose on price, brand and shelf presence.
Private-label retail packaging is where the margin is.
fFN/iGFBP-1 are risk-stratification aids, not diagnostics — label them accordingly.

other.position: Bundle the specialty assays into a single supplier relationship — the value of this series is catalog fill, not any single hero product.
reasoning: H. pylori, CRP, FOB and ferritin are steady high-turnover assays for primary care and pharmacy.
Low-MOQ, mixed-format supply lets a distributor fill gaps without managing multiple vendors.
One trusted source across many SKUs is the procurement story to sell.
